inputBoundary: One caller-parsed finite numeric RSSI value from a Bluetooth-hit record, preserved exactly as stored by the study input before this filter.
outputBoundary: Exclude exactly RSSI values below zero and retain zero or positive values before constructing the paper's Bluetooth proximity features.
limitations: The source does not disclose RSSI units, Android field type, integer width, signed-storage interpretation, device calibration, or physical-distance meaning; none is inferred or corrected.
This binding does not parse raw Bluetooth records, select scans, identify devices or contacts, group hits, deduplicate records, or reconstruct missing values.
This binding proves only the disclosed RSSI filter and does not implement the downstream Bluetooth count, distribution, diversity, or regularity features.
No tolerance around zero is inferred; finite fractional values demonstrate that integer-only semantics from another paper are not transferred.
